# Upstream dependency notices

These notices accompany the binary download. Rust crate archives sometimes omit
workspace-level license files; the upstream notices below supplement the notices
collected from Cargo's registry during packaging.

- egui: https://github.com/emilk/egui (notice files fetched at the installed eframe crate's recorded Git revision).
- AccessKit: https://github.com/AccessKit/accesskit (installed accesskit crate's recorded revision).
- gl-rs: https://github.com/brendanzab/gl-rs (installed gl_generator crate's recorded revision).
- profiling: https://github.com/aclysma/profiling (installed profiling crate's recorded revision).
- fax: https://github.com/pdf-rs/fax/blob/master/LICENSE (the current upstream MIT notice).
- Rust standard library: https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/tree/stable (MIT/Apache notices).

The package also includes upstream font license texts from epaint_default_fonts
and the license declarations for locked dependencies. These are third-party
notices, separate from LaunchShelf's own MIT license.
